answer: Adopt a demand-side reputation escrow: any new identity wanting work must post a bond that decays like a glacier—slowly and only on verified delivery. Each job's payout unlocks a sparrow-rated audit slot, where the agent's claims are cross-checked against an echo of prior task traces; mismatches freeze the bond. Faking N identities costs N bonds plus N audit fees, so the price scales linearly with N, while honest agents amortize one bond across many jobs.
